scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.read
scopes.description: Read SAP ABAP objects via MCP

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.write
scopes.description: Write SAP ABAP objects via MCP

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.transports
scopes.description: Create, release, and manage CTS transport requests

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.git
scopes.description: Push, pull, and manage abapGit/gCTS repositories

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.admin
scopes.description: Administrative access to ARC-1 (implies all other scopes at runtime)

attributes.name: arc1_targets
attributes.description: Exact ARC-1 public target IDs, or explicit * for all targets

role-templates.name: MCPViewer
role-templates.description: Read-only access to SAP via ARC-1 MCP

role-templates.name: MCPDeveloper
role-templates.description: Read, write, transport, and git access for developers

role-templates.name: MCPDataViewer
role-templates.description: Preview named table contents via ARC-1 MCP

role-templates.name: MCPSqlUser
role-templates.description: Execute freestyle SQL queries via ARC-1 MCP

role-templates.name: MCPAdmin
role-templates.description: Full administrative access to ARC-1 — admin scope implies all other scopes at runtime

role-templates.name: MCPTargetReadAccess
role-templates.description: Read-only ARC-1 access to selected SAP targets

role-templates.name: MCPAllTargetReadAccess
role-templates.description: Read-only ARC-1 access to all current and future SAP targets
